title: Ports
removeAllBody: Every forward and reverse rule of this device is removed, and saved rules will not be re-applied. Apps connected through them lose their connection.
reverseHint: The app on the device connects to its own port; adb tunnels it to this {{host}}.

invalid.hostTcp: {{side}}: only TCP ports work on this side.
invalid.kind: {{side}}: use a port number, localabstract:, localreserved:, localfilesystem:, dev:, jdwp: or vsock:.
invalid.jdwp: {{side}}: jdwp needs a process id, e.g. jdwp:5106.

label: Label
idleHint: The rule is applied; nothing is connected to it right now.
inUseHost: Port {{port}} is already used by another app on this {{host}}.
inUseHostBy: Port {{port}} is already used by {{name}} (PID {{pid}}) on this {{host}}.
inUseHostByPid: Port {{port}} is already used by process {{pid}} on this {{host}}.
inUseDevice: Port {{port}} is already used on the device.
reapplied: Rules are re-applied automatically when this device reconnects.
